question: Can one D8-containing even-unimodular extension preserve the source charge/clock class, determinant-only packet response, unchanged fold time, and original vacuum requirement at once?
scope: The verdict EXCLUDED_MARKED_FOLD_COMPLETION applies only to the historical unique-vacuum/unchanged-K/determinant-only comparison class. It does not exclude or downgrade the positive global even-sector factorization W4=U_s R_c proved relative to the stipulated E8 completion. The source-operator addendum starts from the retained original chiral CAR representation on its chosen source circle theta: multiplication by exp(i theta), its fourth power on the folded source-fermion realification V16_source, the folded boundary condition, normal-ordered Q and K_alpha, and the actual v988 finite-cylinder constructor. This source circle is not identified with the P1 seam-core circle; interpreting source winding four as core winding two additionally assumes a double cover. The addendum proves a genuine global charge-four CAR spectral flow, an affine label factorization, and—after the unitary integrable E8 level-one representation Ls is stipulated—a global neutral current-algebra lift R of the affine factor. On the original even D8 Fock sector relative to that stipulated E8 completion, an explicit extension of the ordered source cocycle and the torus factor Z_a prove the global identity W4=U_s R_c. It does not select either representation or the two kappa lift choices from raw P1/P2, identify R_c automatically with the fixed Tits R, extend the equality to an ordinary local odd-CAR/E8 field algebra, turn the global operators into local memory fields, or identify native f/b operators. D8-containing positive even-unimodular lattice extensions with the actual folded D8 currents; the unchanged K(p,N)=|p|^2/2+delta.p+N; the source cocharacter q=(1,...,1); the retained genuinely eight-periodic U(1)-dressed clock and its composition-preserving square C=g^2; and the original determinant-only packet formula in a common carrier/family frame. In Ls, lambda=q/2 is intrinsically a norm-two root, so every genuine E8 lattice isometry transports it as a root; this derives q=2 lambda and unit carrier/family projection norms in the same q frame, but does not select a physical axis, clutch, operator, coupling or statistics. The dressed clock and source-to-field dictionary remain selected premises, not raw P1/P2 derivations. The neutral SU2 statement additionally assumes the standard unitary level-one Ls lattice-current extension. The independent Ls C lift with pair (8,0) is a valid comparison but is not the square of the same unchanged g. The constructive residue bridge additionally retains the prior finite metric N and explicitly marked M3/U3 dictionary; native U3 is not identified with folded source g^2. The triplet-plus-singlet exclusion assumes the separate EXTRA parallel identification. The spectrum/CP corollary is restricted to the old one-A(h), 24-group single-C class (with common h and real coefficients for the CP statement). The six B_F objects are weight labels in a three-dimensional Cartan space; their rank-three h-map is not a complex-linear CCR-preserving isometry of the full native six-boson module. The family-time addendum projects the already retained fold cocharacter delta into the A3 factor of the assumed dressed-clock/E8 frame. Its action is representation-dependent rho_R(delta_F); it is not a P1 derivation, a native W insertion, an adjoint evolution of Cartan residue labels, or a proof of bilocal necessity.
summary_de: Der neue positive Quellenbefund beginnt bei einem echten Operator: Auf dem urspruenglichen chiralen CAR-Raum ist die vierte Windung B4(x)=exp(ix/2)P auf dem gefalteten Quellenfermionraum V16_source randequivariant und CAR-erhaltend; ihr Fock-Implementer W4 hat Ladung vier und erfuellt auf dem gemeinsamen Kern [K_alpha,W4]=W4(Q/2+3/4+alpha/2). Dieser Raum ist nicht der Zieltraeger V16=(10,1)+(1,6); dessen Clifford/CAR-Operatortransfer ist offen. Im zusaetzlich stipulierten unitaeren E8-Level-1-Raum Ls erzeugen vier orthogonale affine su2-Tripel einen globalen neutralen Operator: N^2=-I und R=iN erfuellt R^2=I, [Q,R]=[K,R]=0 und hebt rho auf alle Heisenbergmoden und Wurzelstroeme. Die Quarterphase bleibt erhalten. Auf dem geraden D8-Focksektor relativ zu diesem stipulierten E8 liefert die explizite Erweiterung des geordneten Quellkokzyklus mit dem Torusfaktor Z_a nun ein angepasstes R_c und die globale Identitaet W4=U_s R_c. R_c ist nicht automatisch das feste Tits-R; die beiden kappa-Lifts sind nicht kanonisch ausgewaehlt. Ungerade CAR-Felder, eine gewoehnliche lokale CAR/E8-Algebra, P1-Auswahl und Ereignisgesetz bleiben offen. Auf Ladungslabels zerfaellt dieselbe Wirkung exakt als T=tau_s rho mit rho(p)=Pp+r0; rho erhaelt K und Q und tauscht 0 mit r0 sowie D8 mit D8+s. Auf der reinen Labelstufe ist dies noch kein lokaler R-Lift, Feldkokzyklus oder physische Memory-Faktorisierung; der getrennte globale even-sector Kokzykluslift R_c folgt erst aus den zusaetzlichen E8-Praemissen. W4 reflektiert beta=e0-e4 und permutiert Oszillatoren, also ist es nicht die reine E8-Halbtranslation. Der endliche v988-Halbstring ist dagegen ladungsneutral und aendert den vollen Wilsonloop nicht. Nur in der historischen Unique-Vacuum-/Unchanged-K-/determinant-only-Vergleichsklasse ist die gemeinsame markierte Fold-Vervollstaendigung ausgeschlossen; dieser Verdict betrifft nicht die positive globale even-sector Faktorisierung W4=U_s R_c. Neu traegt die Quellenladung selbst die primitive Richtung: lambda=q/2 ist in Ls eine Norm-2-Wurzel; jede echte E8-Isometrie erhaelt sie als Wurzel, und die Projektionsnormen (1,1) zwingen den gemischten (10,6)-Kanal. Damit folgen q=2lambda und die primitive Traeger-/Familiennorm innerhalb desselben q-Rahmens ohne zusaetzliche Unit-Clutch- oder q=k lambda_m-Annahme. Zusammen mit den Clock-/Ladungsnormen Ls=(4,4), Lc=(6,2) waehlt dies in der determinant-only Paketklasse Ls, |t|=2 und genau zwei m_j=-1; Lc-Norm 2 ist unmoeglich. Zusaetzlich ist die A3-Projektion delta_F des beibehaltenen Fold-Zeitkocharakters fuer alle acht Dressings nichtskalar; ihre sechs Eigenwerte sind {+/-x,+/-1/4,+/-1/4} mit x=3/16 oder1/16 und Muster1+1+2. Ihre Wirkung ist jedoch darstellungsabhaengig rho_R(delta_F); auf den geometrischen Cartanlabels gilt ad(delta_F)h=0. Sie beweist daher weder deren Zeitlauf noch einen nativen bilokalen Vertex. Die sechs Familienmarken docken als Gewichtsetiketten an die vorhandene native (10,6)-W-Paarspur und ueber L=HX/2 an drei N-orthonormale A3-Residuenachsen an. Die Rang-3-Abbildung ist keine CCR-erhaltende Isometrie der sechs nativen Bosonmoden. Das ist noch keine Identifikation von E_lambda mit einem nativen Boson, CAR-Paar, Yukawaoperator, physischer Kopplung oder Statistik. Der neutrale D5-Speicher bleibt ein anderes Objekt. Vollstaendige Cartan-Wardwerte waehlen bedingt |0><0| als normale Anfangsdichte im zweidimensionalen Grundraum. Der geerbte g^2-Lift bleibt vom unabhaengigen (8,0)-Kontrolllift getrennt; eine extra parallele 3+1-Determinantenklasse ist ausgeschlossen. Ereignis-Ueberclaims sind korrigiert: diag(0,1) ist zulaessig, cos(4theta) faltet kanalalternierend, und Stationaritaet verlangt keinen Direktmischer. Es folgt kein physischer Event-, allgemeiner CP-, Feld-, Zeit-, P1/P2- oder TFPT-Abschluss.
summary_en: The new positive source result starts from an actual operator. On the original chiral CAR space the fourth winding B4(x)=exp(ix/2)P on folded source-fermion V16_source is boundary equivariant and CAR preserving; its Fock implementer W4 has charge four and obeys [K_alpha,W4]=W4(Q/2+3/4+alpha/2) on the common core. This is not the target V16=(10,1)+(1,6), whose Clifford/CAR operator transfer remains open. In the additionally stipulated unitary E8 level-one space Ls, four orthogonal affine su2 triples construct a global neutral operator: N^2=-I and R=iN obeys R^2=I, [Q,R]=[K,R]=0 and lifts rho on all Heisenberg modes and root currents. The quarter phase is preserved. On the even D8 Fock sector relative to this stipulated E8, the explicit extension of the ordered source cocycle with torus factor Z_a now gives an adjusted R_c and the global identity W4=U_s R_c. R_c is not automatically the fixed Tits R, and the two kappa lifts are not canonically selected. Odd CAR fields, an ordinary local CAR/E8 algebra, P1 selection and an event law remain open. On charge labels the same action factors exactly as T=tau_s rho with rho(p)=Pp+r0; rho preserves K and Q and exchanges 0 with r0 and D8 with D8+s. At the pure label level this is not yet a local R lift, field cocycle or physical memory factorization; the separate global even-sector cocycle lift R_c uses the additional stipulated E8 premises. W4 reflects beta=e0-e4 and permutes oscillators, so it is not pure E8 half-translation. By contrast, the finite v988 half-string is charge neutral and leaves the full Wilson loop unchanged. Only within the historical unique-vacuum/unchanged-K/determinant-only comparison class is the joint marked fold completion excluded; that verdict does not apply to the positive global even-sector factorization W4=U_s R_c. The source charge itself now supplies the primitive direction: lambda=q/2 is an Ls norm-two root, every genuine E8 lattice isometry preserves it as a root, and projection norms (1,1) force the mixed (10,6) channel. Hence q=2lambda and unit carrier/family projection norms follow in the same q frame without an extra unit-clutch or q=k lambda_m premise. Together with clock/charge norms Ls=(4,4), Lc=(6,2), this selects Ls, |t|=2 and exactly two m_j=-1 in the determinant-only packet class; Lc norm 2 is impossible. In addition, the A3 projection delta_F of the retained fold-time cocharacter is non-scalar for all eight dressings; its six eigenvalues are {+/-x,+/-1/4,+/-1/4}, with x=3/16 or1/16 and pattern1+1+2. Its action is representation-dependent rho_R(delta_F), while ad(delta_F)h=0 on the geometric Cartan labels. It therefore proves neither their time evolution nor a native bilocal vertex. The six family marks dock as weight labels to the existing native (10,6) W-pair slot and, through L=HX/2, to three N-orthonormal A3 residue axes. The rank-three map is not a CCR-preserving isometry of the six native boson modes. This does not identify E_lambda with a native boson, CAR pair, Yukawa operator, physical coupling or statistics. The neutral D5 memory remains distinct. Full Cartan Ward data conditionally select |0><0| as a normal initial density in the two-dimensional ground space. The inherited g^2 lift remains distinct from the independent (8,0) control lift; an extra parallel 3+1 determinant class is excluded. Event overclaims are corrected: diag(0,1) is allowed, cos(4theta) folds into alternating channels, and stationarity requires no direct mixer. No physical event law, general CP, field, time, P1/P2 or TFPT completion follows.

positive_results: Actual chiral source operator: on the chosen source circle, multiplication by exp(i theta) has fourth power B4(x)=exp(ix/2)P on the folded source-fermion realification V16_source. The source circle is not yet the P1 seam-core circle; a double-cover factor is conditional, and no raw-P1/P2-selected local field or transport to the target V16=(10,1)+(1,6) follows.

Common global EVEN-sector factorization, relative to stipulated E8 and not a local odd-CAR identity: the ordered source cocycle extends explicitly from D8 to Ls, and the necessary torus factor Z_a cancels the actual CAR Klein signs. Exact affine marking factorization: on charge labels T=tau_s rho with rho(p)=Pp+r0; rho^2=1, preserves Q and K, and exchanges 0 with r0 and D8 with D8+s. The unmodified geometric segment transition is t_alpha=exp(2pi i alpha Q/8)g_0; g_0 is the compensated periodic clock; W4 retains the quarter-phase character exp(2pi i(3/4+alpha/2))(-1)^Q. W4 reflects beta=e0-e4 and permutes oscillators, so the affine identity alone does not make the global R local, supply a physical memory factor, or by itself prove the calibrated even-sector identity.

Intrinsic mixed-root and joint family selection: lambda=q/2 is an Ls norm-two root. A genuine E8 isometry forces its (1,1) projection into the mixed (10,6) root class, hence q=2lambda with unit carrier/family norms. Combined with Ls=(4,4), Lc=(6,2), the determinant-only packet exists only in Ls with |t|=2 and exactly two m_j=-1; no unit-clutch or q=k lambda_m premise is used. This is not a physical axis, field or clutch selection.

Non-scalar fold-time projection with representation boundary: the action is rho_R(delta_F), while ad(delta_F)h=0 on Cartan labels; no h-axis evolution, native W insertion or bilocal necessity follows. Exactly, ||delta_F||^2 is 41/256 or 33/256 and the six-weight spectrum is {+/-x,+/-1/4,+/-1/4}, x=3/16 or1/16, with a 1+1+2 four-representative.
